name: T1 Trace — an action, its result, and what arrived later
note: Illustrative demo, not a record of actual events. Walks the T1 TRACE of the EIP schema — PERSON -take-> ACTION -yield-> RESULT -yield-> SOLUTION -resolve-> PROBLEM, and RESULT -yield-> SIDE EFFECT -creates-> PROBLEM — as a timeline. The graph says a side effect exists. The timeline says when it showed up.

intervals.label: PROBLEM — displacement pressure on renters
intervals.note: Nobody agrees when this began — hence the 2.5-year start fuzz. Reconstructed after the fact from interviews, so conf is middling.

intervals.label: PERSON — residents organizing
intervals.note: The trace starts with a Person, not with the Action. Overlaps the Problem — which is why there is no link between them: this tool's two relations both require disjoint intervals.

intervals.label: ACTION — purchase campaign
intervals.note: Taken by the Person, addresses the Problem, yields the Result.

intervals.label: RESULT — title transferred to community ownership
intervals.note: PINNED — the only thing here with a document behind it. conf 1 and a hard date; everything else floats around this anchor.

intervals.label: SOLUTION — below-market units occupied
intervals.note: Yielded by the Result, resolves the original Problem. This is the branch everyone celebrated, and the branch everyone kept watching.

intervals.label: SIDE EFFECT — nearby rents and assessments climb
intervals.note: THE POINT OF THIS DEMO. Yielded by the same Result as the Solution — but it starts more than two years later, by which time the campaign had been declared a success and the file was closed. conf 0.45 because attributing it to the purchase is genuinely contested; the 1.2-year start fuzz because nobody was measuring when it began.

intervals.label: PROBLEM — displacement pressure, two blocks over
intervals.note: Created by the Side Effect. The loop closes: the same kind of Problem, a different place, seven years on. Fixes that fail.

links.note: PERSON -take-> ACTION. The campaign begins as the organizing ends.
ACTION -yield/lead_to-> RESULT. Closing starts the day the campaign ends.
RESULT -yield-> SOLUTION. No gap: tenants move in as the transfer completes.
RESULT -yield-> SIDE EFFECT. Same Result, other branch — but 'before', not 'meets', and the gap is over two years wide. On the graph these two yield edges are drawn identically.

SOLUTION -resolve-> PROBLEM, read forward in time: the original Problem is over before the Solution is fully in place. Whether the Action or something else ended it is exactly the kind of claim conf is for.
